title: ToolJet | Build Full-Stack Enterprise Apps in Minutes with AI
excerpt: ToolJet helps you build enterprise apps, AI agents and workflows in minutes, not months. Create secure internal apps that are enterprise ready and SOC2, GDPR and ISO compliant.

Two ways to start

Start the way your team works

Describe the tool in plain English, or drive ToolJet from your coding agent. Either path writes the same application - the same pages, queries, events, and permissions.

For product and ops teamsExplore ToolJet AI

Describe what you need

ToolJet AI turns a sentence into a working draft - real components bound to real queries, ready to refine on the canvas.

Explore ToolJet AI

For developersGet the plugin

Drive it from your coding agent

Install the ToolJet plugin in your coding agent and build from where you already work. It runs as the developer who connected it, with exactly their permissions.

Get the plugin

Connect what you run - or start with nothing

100+ native connectors, plus any REST or gRPC endpoint. Or skip the connection entirely: every workspace includes ToolJet Database, a no-code table editor on top of PostgreSQL, so a tool can ship before anyone provisions a database. Hover a source to see what teams build on it.

ToolJet Database

Built in · nothing to provision

Real PostgreSQL behind a no-code table editor - so a tool can ship before anyone files a database ticket, and still scale when it matters.

Explore

Connect what you already run

Browse all integrations

Enterprise

Freedom to build, without giving up control

Shadow AI becomes shadow IT the moment generated apps sit outside your controls. Identity, permissions, secrets, environments, and audit apply to everything built in ToolJet - whichever person or agent created it.

Transparent by design

Every AI generated output in ToolJet stays visible as structured, visual configuration.

Effortless to maintain
Every page, component, and data query is laid out as visual configuration.

Precise controls
Every part of the app is a visual control, giving you pixel-perfect precision.

Single sign-on

SAML, OIDC, and LDAP, with directory groups mapped onto ToolJet roles.

Granular RBAC

Workspace and app-level permissions, down to individual components and queries.

Audit logs

Actor, action, resource, and timestamp for every change across the workspace.

Where your AI runs

Bring your own LLM keys, or route inference through an on-prem AI gateway.

Encrypted throughout

Data encrypted in transit and at rest, with credentials sealed in the workspace.

Release management

Development, staging, and production environments with promotion controls and rollback.

Administration runs through the agent too

Governance is not a separate console you have to remember to open. Users, groups, roles, and app access are all operable through the same plugin - and every change is attributed to the agent and the person who ran it.

All in one internal tool platform

Impactful internal tools need more than a UI – They need automation to move data and AI agents to handle judgment calls. ToolJet builds all three as one, so your operations run efficiently end to end.

Workflow automation

Automate the processes running behind your internal tools. Sync data between systems, trigger approvals, run scheduled jobs, and send notifications, all without a person driving it manually.

AI app builder

Describe the internal app you need and get a production-ready application in minutes – Dashboards, admin panels, approval tools, whatever your team is running in a spreadsheet today, built and ready to use.

Agent builder

Build AI agents that reason through your operations, not just run them. Triage requests, flag anomalies, and make judgment calls on routine decisions, so your team can focus on what matters.

Self-serve or guided delivery. Always production-ready

Self-serve with AI for full ownership, or partner with our forward engineers for guaranteed delivery. Both paths lead to production-ready apps.

Your team, your apps

Build internal tools using natural language. Your team maintains full ownership and can iterate instantly with AI assistance.

AI builds, you ownInstant iterationsSelf-hosted option

Start building solo

White-glove delivery, guaranteed results

When speed is critical, our forward deployed engineers embed with your team to deliver production-ready apps while ensuring knowledge transfer and flexibility.

Fixed timeline deliveryTeam focused on core productDe-risk critical projects

Schedule a strategy call

Your bill doesn’t grow every time someone uses the tool

Seat-based pricing punishes adoption - every success costs you more, so teams ration access to the tools they just built. ToolJet charges for the people who build, not the people who use.
